continuity: An unidentified person fired an arrow through the latrine door at Jin Taekyung and sent a leather message with it.
The message reads: “Today. Insi. West Gate.”
Jin Taekyung can store and summon physical objects through the System’s Inventory.
plot: Jin Taekyung is attacked by an arrow while using the Nanman Beast Palace's filthy latrine. He pursues the shooter across the Inner Palace but is surrounded by palace warriors after forgetting to pull up his pants, creating a humiliating misunderstanding witnessed by more than two hundred people.

The arrow was not merely an attack: its fletching carried a rolled leather message reading “Today. Insi. West Gate.” Jin retrieves it from his Inventory and shows it to Namho, Sama Pyo, and Taishan as an apparent invitation from an unidentified sender.
translation_decisions: Use Pavilion Master for 각주 when addressing Jin Taekyung.

active_continuity: Jin Taekyung is staying in the Nanman Beast Palace’s Inner Palace as the Third Young Master of the Jin Family of Taiyuan and head of a Murim Alliance pavilion.
An unidentified assailant fired an arrow through the latrine door at Jin Taekyung.
The arrow carried a rolled leather message reading “Today. Insi. West Gate.”
Jin can store and retrieve physical objects through the System’s Inventory.
The message appears to be an invitation from an unidentified sender.
open_questions: Who fired the arrow and sent the leather message?
Was the arrow intended as an attack, an invitation, or both?
What awaits Jin at the West Gate during Insi?
